fine_lines.title: luggage vs baggage
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الكلمتان معناهما حقائب السفر، وكلتاهما اسم غير معدود. luggage جاءت تاريخياً من الفعل lug أي يجرّ الشيء بتعب، فنستخدمها غالباً من وجهة نظر المسافر عن حقائبه الشخصية. baggage هي الكلمة الرسمية التي تستخدمها شركات الطيران والمطارات في اللافتات مثل baggage claim و baggage allowance. ولـ baggage معنى مجازي: الأعباء النفسية والذكريات المؤلمة (emotional baggage)، ولا نقول emotional luggage.

examples.sentence: I have too much luggage for this small car.
You need to drop off your baggage at the desk.
She has a lot of emotional baggage from her past.

fine_lines.explanation_en: Both words mean the bags you take when you travel, and both are uncountable. 'Luggage' comes from the old verb 'lug' (to pull something heavy with effort), so we often use it from the traveller's point of view about their own bags. 'Baggage' is the official word that airlines and airports use on signs, like 'baggage claim' and 'baggage allowance'. 'Baggage' also has a figurative meaning: painful memories and emotional problems from the past ('emotional baggage'). We never say 'emotional luggage'.

fine_lines.title: delay vs postpone
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلاهما فيه معنى التأخير، والفرق في وجود قرار. delay تأخير خارج عن السيطرة بسبب مشكلة مفاجئة مثل الطقس أو الزحام أو عطل فني، ولا أحد يقرره. postpone تأجيل بقرار مقصود أو خطة من شخص أو جهة لنقل الحدث إلى موعد آخر.

examples.sentence: The flight was delayed because of heavy rain.
We decided to postpone our trip until next week.

fine_lines.explanation_en: Both are about something happening later, but the difference is whether someone decided it. A 'delay' is outside anyone's control, caused by a sudden problem like weather, traffic or a technical fault; nobody chooses it. To 'postpone' is to move an event to a later time on purpose, as a decision or plan by a person or organisation.

fine_lines.title: carry-on vs hand luggage
fine_lines.explanation_ar: المعنى واحد: الحقيبة الصغيرة التي تأخذها معك داخل الطائرة. carry-on شائعة في الإنجليزية الأمريكية، و hand luggage شائعة في الإنجليزية البريطانية.

examples.sentence: You can bring one carry-on and one small bag.
Liquids in hand luggage must be under 100 ml.

fine_lines.explanation_en: Same meaning: the small bag you take with you inside the plane. 'Carry-on' is common in American English, and 'hand luggage' is common in British English.

fine_lines.title: departure vs arrival
fine_lines.explanation_ar: departure مغادرة مكان والانطلاق منه، و arrival الوصول إلى المكان. في المطار ستجد لوحة departures للرحلات المغادرة ولوحة arrivals للرحلات القادمة.

examples.sentence: Check the departure board for your gate.

fine_lines.explanation_en: 'Departure' means leaving a place and starting your journey; 'arrival' means reaching a place. At the airport you'll see a 'Departures' board for flights leaving and an 'Arrivals' board for flights coming in.

grammar.title: Future continuous + present simple: a short action interrupts a longer one
grammar.explanation_ar: عندما يقطع حدث قصير حدثاً أطول سيكون مستمراً في المستقبل، نضع الحدث الطويل في المستقبل المستمر (will be + ing) والحدث القصير في المضارع البسيط بعد when أو by the time.
examples: I'll be watching a movie when Ahmed arrives.
I'll be waiting at the gate when the plane lands.
When you get home tonight, I'll be packing my luggage.
grammar.explanation_en: When a short event interrupts a longer action that will be in progress in the future, we put the long action in the future continuous (will be + -ing) and the short event in the present simple after 'when' or 'by the time'.

grammar.title: No 'will' after time words (when, before, after, as soon as)
grammar.explanation_ar: بعد أدوات الربط الزمنية مثل when و before و after و as soon as و by the time نستخدم المضارع البسيط حتى لو كان المعنى مستقبلاً. لا تقل when Ahmed will arrive، فهذه ترجمة حرفية من العربية؛ الصحيح when Ahmed arrives.
examples: I'll check in before the gate closes.
We'll leave as soon as the rain stops.
grammar.explanation_en: After time words like 'when', 'before', 'after', 'as soon as' and 'by the time', we use the present simple even when we mean the future. Don't say 'when Ahmed will arrive'; the correct form is 'when Ahmed arrives'.

questions.question: The flight was ___ because of a storm. (no one decided it)
questions.explanation_en: A delay is outside anyone's control, so the answer is 'delayed'.

questions.question: The company decided to ___ the meeting until Monday.
questions.explanation_en: To move something later on purpose, by decision = postpone.

questions.question: Which is correct?
choices: She has a lot of emotional luggage.
She has a lot of emotional baggage.
questions.explanation_ar: المعنى المجازي للأعباء النفسية يأتي فقط مع baggage، وهي غير معدودة.
questions.explanation_en: The figurative meaning (emotional problems) only works with 'baggage', and it is uncountable.

questions.question: I'll be waiting at the gate when the plane ___.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد when نستخدم المضارع البسيط lands.
questions.explanation_en: After 'when' we use the present simple: 'lands'.

questions.question: When you get home tonight, I ___ my luggage.
questions.explanation_ar: الحدث الطويل المستمر الذي يقطعه وصولك = will be packing.
questions.explanation_en: The long action in progress that your arrival interrupts = will be packing.

questions.question: "She passed the exam with flying colours" means she:
Where do you collect your bags after landing?

questions.question: Which word has a silent letter in normal speech?
questions.explanation_ar: حرف t صامت في fasten، مثل listen.
questions.explanation_en: The 't' in 'fasten' is silent, like in 'listen'.

questions.question: A small bag you take inside the plane is called in American English a:
questions.explanation_ar: carry-on أمريكية، و hand luggage بريطانية.
